text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Guuuuugh...! I couldn't win the race, and 
I couldn't beat Daijin either-rrgh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And I was so determined to win!! I wanted 
to win so, so, so badly~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Next time too... I'll beat you in the 
Satsuki Sho as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat you at your best, with 
everything I've got.

Winning Ticket's tear-stained eyes glared 
intensely at Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose next time either!! 
Definitely!! Absolutely, positively, no 
way in hell!!

Days of training were about to begin for 
the next race, the Satsuki Sho, where 
formidable rivals awaited.
